summary: The study investigates the physical and electrical properties of Sr xTi1−xOy-based metal-insulator-metal capacitors prepared by atomic layer deposition using TiN bottom electrodes. The focus is on the impact of Sr/Ti ratio on the properties of the films, including crystallization behavior, dielectric constant, leakage current, and interfacial equivalent oxide thickness (EOT). The results show that Sr-enrichment leads to a decrease in dielectric constant and leakage current, and the crystallization temperature and film texture are influenced by the Sr/Ti ratio.
